newsitem.title: UK: Shell buys Esso UK Quadrant Gas stake.
newsitem.headline: Shell buys Esso UK Quadrant Gas stake.

text.p: Royal Dutch/Shell Group said it has raised its share in marketing company Quadrant Gas Ltd to 100 percent by buying the 50 percent held by Esso UK, part of Exxon Corp.
"Shell UK aims to consolidate Quadrant's position as a key player in the (British) industrial and commercial market," Shell said in a statement.
Quadrant was set up in 1989 to supply natural gas to industrial and commercial users shortly before this segment of the UK gas market was opened up to competition.
Stuart Tesler, who was commercial manager responsible for gas sales in Shell UK Exploration and Production, has been appointed new managing director of Quadrant.
Quadrant employs 120 people. Shell's acquisition of Esso UK's interest, which industry sources said had been discussed for some time, would not result in any job losses, Shell said.
Quadrant made net profit of 1.5 million stg in 1995 on turnover of 120 million stg. Shell said Quadrant had a share of about six percent in the British commercial and industrial gas market.
